title: Chunk
description: One line of chunks.jsonl and one row of the chunks table.

id.description: sha256 of repo, path, start_line and text; stable across re-runs.

path.description: File path relative to the repo root.

symbol.description: Qualified function or class name, or the heading for docs; null if none.

language.description: tree-sitter language name, or markdown / text.

source_url.description: GitHub link to the exact lines at commit_sha.

file_hash.description: sha256 of the whole file; unchanged means skip re-embedding.

token_count.description: Llama-3.1 tokens in text, header included.

text.description: One-line header (repo, path, lines, symbol) followed by the chunk content.
